title: CI/CD pipeline for your project
text: Every push tested and built automatically, and every merge to main deployed. A broken build never reaches your users.

title: Dockerize your app and deploy it to the cloud
text: Small, non-root images and one docker compose file, so your app runs the same on my laptop, your server and the cloud.

title: Monitoring and alerts for a running service
text: Health checks and alerts that reach your phone, so you hear about downtime before your customers do.
